notes.title: Demo Week 1 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Demo Week One Update
The public demo has been live for over a week now. Thank you to all players who have experienced the game and provided feedback! Based on your input, we've fixed a series of issues.
Update Contents
Fixed a bug where checking the Notebook too early in the tutorial could cause errors

Fixed a bug where potion information wasn't recorded in the tutorial

Fixed a bug where some text was too long and extended outside the frame

Fixed missing enemy/research information for some late-game content

Fixed a bug where selecting an unopened map would cause UI errors

Fixed a bug where background music would be lost after undoing on several maps

Fixed a bug where inventory information would be cleared after undoing

Fixed a bug where undoing could cause blank equipment to appear in equipment slots

Fixed a bug where using spacebar to pick up items could sometimes result in an extra action

Fixed a bug where animations on enemies out of the screen may freeze until they are in the screen

Fixed missing translations and mistranslations in the English version


Community
Join our community groups to communicate with the development team and other players:


Discord: https://discord.gg/Jq3va9JAyX



In the groups you may:

Stay updated on development progress

Share suggestions and feedback

Participate in game discussions

Preview new content

Connect with other players

You can also provide feedback through Steam discussion forum.


Content Preview
We will release detailed major content reports in future updates. As a bonus for this update announcement, we've randomly selected a late-game equipment/skill to preview (UI in the image is still being implemented and optimized):
